task_summary: Build a Python function that extracts chemical names from a PDF, resolves them to SMILES via PubChem, computes Morgan fingerprint Tanimoto similarity against a target molecule, and returns the top-k most similar chemicals sorted by descending similarity with alphabetical tie-breaking.
decomposition_rationale: The task has three distinct functional domains: (1) extracting chemical names from a PDF, (2) converting chemical names to molecular representations via PubChem, and (3) computing fingerprint-based similarity and ranking results. However, since the pipeline is tightly coupled and the background research document provides a near-complete unified solution, decomposing into 2 skills—one for PDF extraction/name resolution and one for similarity computation/ranking—provides clean separation without over-decomposition.

skills.name: evo-chem-pdf-extraction
skills.description: Extracts chemical names from a PDF file and resolves them to SMILES strings using PubChemPy. Handles PDF parsing with pdfplumber, text cleaning, and PubChem API rate limiting with retries.
skills.responsibility: PDF text extraction, chemical name parsing/cleaning, and chemical name to SMILES resolution via PubChem API. Does NOT compute similarity.
dr_sections: 2. PDF Text Extraction of Chemical Names
2.3 Best Practices for Cleaning and Parsing Extracted Text
3. Converting Chemical Names to SMILES via PubChemPy
3.2 Error Handling, Rate Limits, and Edge Cases
3.3 Working Code: Name to SMILES Converter

skills.name: evo-chem-tanimoto-similarity
skills.description: Computes Morgan fingerprint-based Tanimoto similarity between molecules using RDKit 2025+ APIs, and provides the top-k ranking pipeline with proper tie-breaking. Integrates with the PDF extraction skill to form the complete solution.
skills.responsibility: SMILES to RDKit Mol conversion, Morgan fingerprint generation using the modern rdFingerprintGenerator API (radius=2, fpSize=2048, includeChirality=True), Tanimoto similarity computation, top-k sorting with descending similarity and alphabetical tie-breaking, and the main `topk_tanimoto_similarity_molecules` function.
dr_sections: 4.4 Complete Working Code: SMILES to Tanimoto
5. Common Pitfalls and Edge Cases Summary
